title: Homophones practice sheet
subject: English
source: Written for english/y4 lesson 90 (Homophones practice sheet (pupil PDF))
intro: Lesson 90: Spelling: homophones (whose, who's, weather, whether and more). Read the ideas from the lesson, then do the tasks.

head: Pair
Meaning
rows: simple, or flat land / an aircraft
a tie in rope / the opposite of yes

parts.text: Try who is: Who is suitcase? No

panels.title: Memory tricks
points: whether has an h for if... how?
the plane has an e for engine

keywords.def: words that sound the same but have different meanings and spellings
rain, sun, wind and so on

questions.q: I asked ___ we could stop. (weather / whether)
The desert is a dry ___. (plain / plane)
Extend: write one sentence using both words of two pairs
questions.a: For example: I don't know whether the weather will change.

questions.q: Stretch: invent a memory trick for accept / except
We flew on a ___ to New York.
questions.a: C) plane. A plane is an aircraft. Plain means simple or flat land.
